title: Tales of Japan | A Family Journey through Culture & Adventure
highlights: Discover the perfect family getaway across Tokyo, Kyoto, and Osaka, where ancient traditions meet futuristic fun, and every moment promises joy for all ages.
Enhance your Japan journey with a stay in a ryokan at Kyoto, where sliding doors, garden courtyards, and tatami floors highlight centuries-old hospitality of the country.
Explore Nabana no Sato, home to Japan’s longest light tunnel, where millions of LEDs weave glowing patterns across fields and floral displays in a breathtaking spectacle.
Shop your heart out at Gotemba Premium Outlets, Japan’s largest luxury outlet nestled at the foot of Mt. Fuji, offering stunning views and unbeatable deals on global brands.
Watch your kids light up with joy at Tokyo Disneyland, where fairy tales come alive through thrilling rides and fun-filled encounters with their favourite Disney characters.
overview:
About the Tour:
Experience the best of Japan in this 9-day family adventure across Tokyo, Kyoto, and Osaka. Explore ancient temples and neon skylines, meet beloved Disney characters, witness Mt. Fuji’s majesty, cruise Hakone’s lake, shop at Gotemba Outlets, stroll through Kyoto’s bamboo forest, and ride the scenic Arashiyama train. From Universal Studios thrills to magical moments at Nabana no Sato, every day blends culture, fun, and unforgettable memories for all ages.

know_before_you_go: ID proof is mandatory for each guest at the time of booking and also upon arrival. PAN card will not be considered a valid address proof.
All international participants will have to share passport and visa details on arrival.
Learn basic Japanese phrases like "Konnichiwa" (hello) and "Arigatou" (thank you).
﻿﻿Remove your shoes when entering someone's house, a traditional house, or a temple in Japan.
Always remember not to leave chopsticks upright in a bowl of rice, as it's considered disrespectful.
Using your phone for calls during a train or bus journey is considered inappropriate etiquette in Japan.

The cancellation terms for any bookings or packages will be governed by the specific cancellation policy related to the land package. This means that any cancellations must adhere to the terms and conditions outlined in the land package's cancellation policy.

Thrillophilia's visa policy emphasizes that the company is not liable or responsible for any issues related to visa applications. This includes situations where a visa is rejected or delayed, or if there are any delays or errors in the documentation process. The responsibility and control over visa matters lie solely with the respective embassy.
Guests must note that entry ticket to Todai-ji Temple requires a separate fee of ¥600 per person, payable directly at the entrance.
For all the activities that have a designated common meet and drop point, guests are responsible for arranging their own transportation to and from the location.

Kindly note that hotel taxes range from JPY 500–1,000 per person per day for five-star hotels, JPY 200 per person per day for four-star hotels, and JPY 100 per person per day for three-star hotels and below.
Ensure your luggage does not exceed 160 cm in total dimensions to comply with size restrictions while travelling via bullet train.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Tokyo | Day at Leisure
days.desc: Upon arrival at the airport, get driven to the hotel. Post check in, take time to unwind. Later, feel free to explore Tokyo at your leisure. You can visit Sumida Park, offering a relaxing spot against the views of Sumeda River. Another option is Edo-Tokyo Museum, where life-size models illustrate city's transformation from a small Edo-era town to modern metropolis it is today. For something thrilling, you can try driving a go-kart through the actual streets of Tokyo with Street Kart Tokyo Bay.

items.title: Check-in at Shinjuku Washington Hotel Annex

days.title: Tokyo Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Today, proceed to Love Sculpture & board the transfer for a Tokyo city tour. Visit Meiji Jingu Shrine, dedicated to Emperor Meiji & Imperial Palace, the main residence of Japan’s Emperor. Also, explore Sensoji Temple, city's oldest Buddhist temple & Nakamise-dori Street, full of an array of traditional shops. Don’t miss marvelling at Red Tokyo Tower's architecture & enjoy the lively vibe of Roppongi. Later, get dropped off at Shinjuku St. West Exit. From there, proceed to the hotel on your own.

items.title: Tokyo Sightseeing Tour - Departure from Shinjuku LOVE Statue (With Lunch)

days.title: Trip to Mount Fuji, Hakone & Gotemba Outlets
days.desc: From your hotel, make your way to Shinjuku Center Building & board the transfer for a full-day tour. Start by visiting Mt. Fuji 5th Station, where you can enjoy views of Fuji Five Lakes. Then, stop at Gotemba Premium Outlets, home to 200+ global brands stores. Also, enjoy Hakone ropeway ride, gliding above sulphur fields as you head toward Owakudani, a famous volcanic valley. Don’t miss a cruise on Lake Ashi aboard the Hakone Pirate Ship before being dropped off at Shinjuku Station’s West Exit.

items.title: Trip to Mt Fuji 5th Station, Hakone & Gotemba Outlets

days.title: Day Trip to Disneyland
days.desc: Today, prepare for a fun-filled adventure at Disneyland Tokyo. Once you arrive, dive into Adventureland, where you can sail with pirates on the Pirates of the Caribbean ride or take a jungle river cruise. Alternatively, step into Fantasyland, featuring attractions like Peter Pan’s Flight, It’s a Small World & the iconic Cinderella Castle. During your visit, also enjoy vibrant parades, entertaining stage shows & end the day with a fireworks display that lights up the night sky with Disney magic.

days.title: Transfer to Kyoto | Day at Leisure
days.desc: Check out & head to Tokyo Station to board the famous Shinkansen train to Kyoto. Enjoy a journey at a speed of up to 320 km/h, offering comfort & scenic views along the way. Upon arriving, proceed to the hotel & check in at a traditional Ryakon stay. Later, you can spend the day at your leisure. You may visit Kyoto Imperial Palace, once home to Japan’s Imperial Family, or stroll through Gion district, famous for its geisha culture & traditional architecture, among various other attractions.

items.title: Transfer in Bullet Train (Shinkansen)
items.desc: 1 X Bullet Train (Shinkansen) will be Provided

items.title: Check-in at Kyoto Ryokan Gion Sano

days.title: Kyoto, Nara & Arashiyama Sightseeing Tour | Arashiyama Sagano Train Experience
days.desc: Today, get driven to Kyoto St. & board the board the bus for a wonderful tour. Explore Nara Park, where you can interact with deer roaming freely & Fushimi Inari Taisha, famous for its vibrant red gates. After that, get driven to Kyoto Station to board the connecting train to Torokko Saga Station & enjoy Sagano Train ride, gliding alongside Hozugawa River. Post-ride, disembark & stroll through Kimono & Bamboo Forest, two most unique attractions of Arashiyama. Later, get driven back to the hotel.

items.title: Kyoto & Nara Sightseeing Tour - Departure from Kyoto
Arashiyama Sightseeing Tour - Departure from Kyoto

days.title: Transfer to Osaka | Sakura Magic & Nabana no Sato Illumination Tour
days.desc: Check out & head to Kyoto St. to take a train to Osaka. Post reaching, head to the hotel & check in. Later, go to Daikokucho St. & take a train to Mainichi Newspaper Building. As you reach, enjoy sukiyaki lunch in Sekigahara & a train ride on Yoro Railway for countryside views, followed by Ogaki rafting ride via cherry-lined canals. Also, visit Nabana no Sato, where flower gardens & Tunnel of Lights create a memorable time. Later, take a train back to Osaka & then head to the hotel on your own.

items.title: Transfer in Bullet Train (Shinkansen)
items.desc: 1 X Bullet Train (Shinkansen) will be Provided

items.title: Check-in at APA Hotel Shin Osaka Ekimae
Sakura Magic & Nabana no Sato Tour

days.title: Day Trip to Universal Studios
days.desc: Today, get transferred to Universal Studios & enjoy a full-day adventure. Wander through The Wizarding World of Harry Potter, where towering castles & magical shops bring J.K. Rowling’s world to life. Enter Super Nintendo World & feel as though you’ve jumped right into a video game. Also, stroll through the playful streets of Minion Park & enjoy the prehistoric excitement of Jurassic Park, which offers heart-racing rides & encounters with towering dinosaurs. Later, get driven back to the hotel.

days.title: Departure Day
days.desc: After checking out, get transferred to Kansai International Airport to board your flight back home. Reflect on the incredible memories made throughout your journey, from exploring vibrant cityscapes & historic temples to enjoying thrilling theme parks & scenic landscapes.
